title: Rabbitmq messaging topology operator: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object… (CVE-2026-116585)
description: CVE-2026-116585 is a medium severity vulnerability affecting the rabbitmq-messaging-topology-operator due to issues in Go JOSE, a Go implementation of Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards. The flaw impacts versions prior to 1.16.0-r5, 2.9.1-r1, and 2.8.4-r1. A fix is available in these versions. No known exploits are reported in the wild.
